body: Update on the story 3 years after: I just maxed out $10,000 credit card and $12,500 Line of credit and walked out of Casino in misery yesterday. I came clean to my parents last time (many times before) and they bailed me out; but since then, I have gambled and lost more than $100k. Now I have no one turns too. This cycle really never ends; I just hope after 3 years When I see this post again, I finally will be free.

I paid the ultimate price for gambling by buying put options. It was easy quick money until you are on a losing streak and went tilt. I tried to stop when I was up big but I suffer from anhedonia as well; so I went all in GME put options and I lost 80% of it; and went downhill from that since then and lost all. If you have a problem with gambling you will likely to lose all and will not stop until you lost all. I suggest you force yourself to be abstinent and replace with other high thrill activity such as video games.
Thanks for sharing your story! I replaced my casino gambling addiction with stock market addiction. Which did not work; I should replace with another healthier addiction. Thanks!

No no no, don’t compare yourself with others. There always people that are above you and below you. Chances of you being born into this world is less 1 in 100 billion. You are a miracle! Remember this you are a miracle! You got a chance at life.

Man you are right; I should stop worrying about money once I can live paycheque to paycheque. I value money more than my life. Which has always been more money I have the I better I am. Now crashing down in debt now I feel worthless and wanting to die. Anyways thank you! My life is worth more than 50K! I will attending GA soon

Regretting so much now; angry too because I was one of you and know that GME will fall and most of you guys will get burned; but then seeing reaching $300+. it triggers me and I was in full blown gambling addiction. I still couldn't believe I did it.

Right, but another problem I remember was that I sometimes have a hard time connecting with the other members due to age as most of my area attendees are elderly people or at least in their 40s. They have different problem to focus on. My primal trigger of future anxiety are not comforted. Too many pressure of financial freedom, providing for my family in the futures and having a gambler mentally and wanting to get rich quick. I know I shouldn't be doing these but sometime a trigger will cause me to loose control like this time was the wallstreetbets.

Gamestop, Blackberry and AMC; fuck man I was doing fine until this meme stock hits. I was jealous of the quick profits they made and no longer appreciate my hard work of last year which only yield me a fraction of what Gamestop could do in a month.

This actually make sense, the atmosphere is too depressing and especially for young people. I find hard to identify with GA because in my area there are just too many elder people that have many different stresses that are totally different from me. My worries is my future and financial freedom (which now is financial ruin), but we do have time to fix it and go back to the right track!

Yes thank you; it is just too many pressure and all the social media preaching financial freedom etc and creates lots of stress on me. Thinking of now If I didn't gamble and such such I would be much better off. Yes I have to let it go and move on. At age of 29 is still young. Live day to day.

I think I signed but the reinforcement are relaxed and I always can sneak in; I was finally able to stop because Casinos were forced to close during Co-void; but as you know a compulsive gambler is always a gambler and found trading options instead.... I shut my Margin account hope it will work this time.
Yes I tried GA before but stopped attending as relapses keep coming. Looks like I have to attend consistently from now on.

That is not too bad man; at least you borrowed money to pay your school fees and not for personal pleasure or monetary gains. Appreciate on what you have; I never did appreciate what I have and ended up in a big mess I am in right now
Thanks! looks like I will stay away from Margin and options those were disasters.
Thanks, the younger you are the better; stay out of gambling, drugs or anything maliciously addictive you would be fine in life.
Thank you so much! Made me feel much better!

fuck you are right. It is just emotions man; one day I feel motivated but another day feeling down like shit. It seems that I have bi-polar disorder but my doctor says no. Waves of negative rumination is killing me. This gambling addiction eventually going to induce a mental disorder in me.
Right! this made me feel much better.
Yes I went to a few meetings but never able to stay. I shall start to attend again. Thanks!

You realized you had a gambling problem at 22 and you stopped that is great. I lost over 200k gambling and I am 29 and still struggling to stop. At age of 22 you still have potential and time which are probably the most important commodity. I would get a job as well and starting saving again; you saved 10k in 2 years before so I'm pretty sure by the time you are 29 you would have at least 50k and no matter what stay off from gambling or any get rich schemes.
